# The Chronicle of anomalyco/opencode

*19 months · 15,796 commits · 991 contributors · 27 releases*

anomalyco/opencode began on 21 March 2025, with Kujtim Hoxha’s first commit. In the 19 months since, 991 hands have laid 15,796 commits, and the island has grown to 6,630 files. Its story is told in six chapters, season by season.

## I. The First Stones

*March – June 2025 · 292 files at its end*

The island rose from the sea with 28 files and grew to 292, over 1,102 commits.

- Kujtim Hoxha laid the first stone: a first commit of 28 files, in `internal` and `cmd`.
- The guild grew by 40 hands; Dax Raad and Aiden Cline would do the most.
- `v0.0.1` went out: the first galleon left the harbour.
- Two places rose from the sea together: `packages/opencode` and `packages/web`.
- `internal` became `packages/tui`.
- The busiest week began on 13 June 2025: 216 commits.
- Besides, four smaller places rose.
- One more release followed: `v0.1.0`.

## II. The Growing Season

*July – September 2025 · 1,880 files at its end*

The island tripled in size, from 292 files to 1,880, over 1,804 commits.

- 40 new hands joined the guild, opencode and David Hill among them.
- A new place rose from the sea: `packages/sdk`; in time it would hold 329 files.
- The busiest week began on 8 August 2025: 226 commits.
- The first stones of `packages/app` were laid; in time it would hold 1,137 files.
- 1,133 files were moved and remade in one commit.
- `cloud` took a new name: `packages/cloud`.
- Besides, eight smaller places rose and one more place took a new name.
- Twelve releases went out, from `v0.2.0` to `v0.13.2`.

## III. The Rise of `ui`

*October – December 2025 · 2,612 files at its end*

Across three months the island grew from 1,880 files to 2,612, over 3,556 commits.

- `packages/app` became `packages/desktop`.
- The guild grew by 105 hands; Frank and Luke Parker would do the most.
- `packages/ui` broke new ground; in time it would hold 1,713 files.
- A new major, `v1.0.0`: the town turned out to see the galleon off.
- `packages/tauri` was founded, and a new place rose from the sea.
- Two great reshapings: one commit moved and remade 2,301 files, another 2,256.
- The busiest week began on 5 December 2025: 589 commits.
- `packages/tauri` sank back into the sea after four weeks.
- Besides, seven smaller places rose.
- Two more releases followed: `v0.14.0` and `v0.15.0`.

## IV. The Guild Swells

*January – March 2026 · 4,489 files at its end*

The island grew from 2,612 files to 4,489, over 4,246 commits.

- 87 new hands joined the guild, Kit Langton and James Long among them.
- The busiest week began on 16 January 2026: 606 commits.
- A new place rose from the sea: `packages/storybook`.
- A new place rose from the sea: `packages/desktop-electron`; in time it would hold 218 files.
- Besides, two smaller places rose.
- Three releases went out: `v1.1.1`, `v1.2.0` and `v1.3.0`.

## V. The Months of Building

*April – June 2026 · 6,079 files at its end*

Across three months the island grew from 4,489 files to 6,079, over 3,878 commits.

- The guild grew by 16 hands; Aarav Sareen and Victor Navarro would do the most.
- `packages/util` became `packages/shared`.
- A single commit reshaped 649 files.
- `packages/desktop-electron` sank back into the sea after two months.
- The first stones of `packages/llm` were laid; in time it would hold 152 files.
- In the week of 8 May 2026 the hammers never stopped: 584 commits.
- `packages/stats` was founded, and a new place rose from the sea; in time it would hold 123 files.
- Besides, twelve smaller places rose and one more place took a new name.
- Five releases went out, from `v1.4.0` to `v1.17.0`.

## VI. v2 Sets Sail

*July – October 2026 · 6,630 files at its end*

The island grew from 6,079 files to 6,630, over 1,209 commits.

- Two places rose from the sea together: `packages/codemode` and `artifacts`.
- In the week of 3 July 2026 the hammers never stopped: 153 commits.
- Nine new hands joined the guild, vprdev and Daniel Chen among them.
- `v2.0.0` set sail, a new major, and the harbour hung out its bunting.
- `artifacts` sank back into the sea after three months.
- One more release followed: `v1.18.0`.

---

*The tale is still being written: the island stands at 6,630 files in 40 places, and the last stone was laid on 8 October 2026.*
